The 7-day figure checks out, but it's window-shopping. Over the actual 30-day evaluation window Trader 014 is down $4.75M — SOL -4.47M, XRP -631K, zero winning trades on both. The recent week is a small bounce (mostly ZEC) against a massive drawdown. Small size only.

A 100% win rate over a week with only three coins is a tell: tiny mean wins masking the tail. The same wallet's 30-day record shows zero winning SOL and XRP trades and -$4.7M realised. This is re-presenting the same cherry-picked week. Evidence still points the wrong way.
